timing: Read after the frozen campaign; does not change cases, methods, thresholds or protocol.

rows.title: Equivalence test and confidence interval for the difference in proportions for the paired-sample design
rows.problem_and_assumptions: Paired binary responses and a prespecified inferiority margin under a correlated response model.
rows.algorithm: Efficient-score test and score interval for the paired marginal difference.
rows.domain: Paired clinical/diagnostic comparisons; mathematics potentially relevant to valid robot pairs.
rows.reported_result: The author reports improved small-sample behavior and applicability when off-diagonal cells are zero.
rows.limits: Inspected primary PDF introduction/summary; no numerical implementation or coverage replication here. The paper uses equivalence terminology for a one-sided inferiority formulation; this study preserves the charter's separate NI and two-sided equivalence meanings.
rows.artifacts_and_reproduction: Primary paper accessible; software release not verified. Reproduction would require a separate exact reference and coverage study.
rows.overlap: Paired loss-difference inference cannot be replaced by aggregate success totals.
rows.remaining_question: Which construction meets a future frozen sampling/cluster/sequential design? Not needed for today's deterministic finite bounds.

rows.title: Unconditional exact tests for equivalence or noninferiority for paired binary endpoints
rows.authors: H. M. Hsueh, J. P. Liu, J. J. Chen
rows.problem_and_assumptions: Correlated binary response rates in small paired samples.
rows.algorithm: Unconditional exact tests using sample-based and constrained maximum-likelihood statistics; inversion to difference intervals.
rows.baselines: Asymptotic paired tests and confidence intervals.
rows.reported_result: Authors report exact p-values generally larger and intervals wider than the compared asymptotic procedures.
rows.limits: Primary abstract and publication metadata inspected; full proofs/code not audited. No robot or optional-stopping guarantee follows automatically.
rows.artifacts_and_reproduction: Article identified; executable implementation not verified.
rows.overlap: Established exact/conservative machinery precedes a proprietary paired admission gate.
rows.remaining_question: Independently implement only after a stochastic qualification protocol actually requires it.

rows.title: Improved confidence intervals for the difference between binomial proportions based on paired data
rows.problem_and_assumptions: Marginal risk difference from individually paired binary data.
rows.algorithm: Profile likelihood and score-based alternatives compared for coverage.
rows.baselines: Asymptotic and conditional exact interval constructions.
rows.reported_result: The paper identifies inadequate coverage/one-sided behavior in some existing constructions and evaluates alternatives.
rows.limits: Primary PDF summary inspected; detailed algorithms and simulation results not reproduced.
rows.artifacts_and_reproduction: Primary paper accessible; code release not verified.
rows.overlap: Calling a conditional procedure exact does not establish an appropriate difference interval for Nisayon's estimand.
rows.remaining_question: Validate a chosen implementation against exhaustive multinomial examples and design-specific coverage, if a future protocol needs it.
